ruleDefinitions.name: ShimCache Flush
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects actions that clear the local ShimCache and remove forensic evidence

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*rundll32.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*apphelp\\\.dll.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*ShimFlushCache.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\#250.*"))) OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*rundll32.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*kernel32\\\.dll.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*BaseFlushAppcompatCache.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\#46.*")))
